title: Linked Checking Account APY Boosts for Savings Accounts
summary: This document lists the specific linked checking + savings account pairings that automatically apply a bonus APY boost to your savings account balance under the same customer profile (e.g., Green Account + Gold Account; Blue Account + Silver Plus; Purple Account + Platinum Plus). It states the boost is additive to savings’ base APY and any credit card APY bonuses, and that only the listed pairings qualify—other combinations do not. Exact APY boost percentages are not provided here and must be found in each savings account’s documentation.
